turns.q: How long does it normally take to ship and send a tracking number?
turns.replyTail:
to ship and send a tracking number?
Nuk • AI Assistant
Consumer orders normally ship within two days. A tracking number is typically sent once the order has shipped.
After shipment, delivery usually takes:
- Eastern USA: two to six days
- Florida: five to eight days
- Central/Western USA: three to six days
If it has already been a few days with no tracking, your order may still be processing. Please let me know if you require further clarification.
